exposure: severely decreased level of consciousness at admission
cohort: Obstetric patients admitted to Addis Ababa Public hospital's intensive care unit from October 2018 to November 2020.
finding: Maternal age >=35 years, lack of antenatal care, puerperal sepsis, severe pre-eclampsia, pre-existing medical comorbidities, and severely decreased level of consciousness during ICU admission were significantly associated with obstetric mortality.
